preconditions: PRE-N

expected_result:
Pill outline buttons with arrow; hover/focus visible and consistent
Also: Variants (primary, secondary, outline pill with arrow), sizes, disabled state, loading state, onClick not fired when disabled, accessible name for icon-only buttons
At 1280: Figma frames are 1440 wide. At 1280: fixed-size elements (type, icons, buttons, card heights, paddings, gaps, radii, colours, effects) must match Figma 1:1; fluid containers fill the content area (1280 − 248 nav − 2 × 24 padding = 984 px) and grids re-flow — record the 1280 layout (see OQ-1280).
